text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
—"Go to the amusement park together"? ...I 
don't have time for that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
..."Class after-party"... Ridiculous... 
Something like that isn't for me...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like you've got your hands full 
too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
—I have a goal that I must accomplish. I 
have no time to be looking away...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...That's right. I don't have time to 
play nice with anyone.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...I'll push forward, all on my own.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
To dedicate a victory to her... I will 
keep running for her sake as well.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Still, Ayabe-senpai is... She seems 
similar to me, yet different. Deep down in 
her heart—there is something steadfast.)
